channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Meiji Yasuda to buy Man Group stake in asset management push
item.description: The Japanese insurer plans to acquire 5% of Man Group, the world's largest publicly traded hedge fund.

item.title: Former Prime Minister Yasuo Fukuda dies at 90
item.description: The son of former Japanese leader Takeo Fukuda became the country's first second-generation prime minister when he assumed office in September 2007.

item.title: Japan’s shipbuilders ramping up investment to double output
item.description: The overall amount of investments is on track to exceed ¥1 trillion.

item.title: 70% in Japan want to shelter at home after disasters, survey finds
item.description: Only about 15% of respondents had a detailed understanding of the preparations needed to shelter at home.

item.title: Japan is known for world-class events - but the Asian Games were chaotic
item.description: Hotel chaos, transport mishaps and diplomatic blunders cast a spotlight on organisers and the firm hired to deliver the games.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
